preconditions.description: The attacker must be able to call the vulnerable function (addCoverOwner) on the CoverData contract. Note: The provided source code is for UniswapV2Router02, but the vulnerability description refers to a CoverData contract with an addCoverOwner function. Assuming the target address contains the vulnerable CoverData contract.

exploit_hint: Directly call the addCoverOwner function with the attacker's address as parameter to gain cover owner privileges without any authorization check. This allows unauthorized privilege escalation in the cover system.
